notes: Jobs (a.k.a. classes) authorable from the editor.
branch: groups jobs in the same progression line (e.g. warrior → knight).
tier: 1 = starter, 2 = unlocked when prerequisite job hits minLevel.
unlockRequirement: { jobId, minLevel } — prereq from same branch.
Each level may grant statBonus, grantsSkills, grantsPassives, special.
Backward-compatible: party members without a currentJob behave as before.

entries.name: Warrior
entries.description: Frontline melee specialist. Builds the foundation that knights and berserkers later refine.

levels.description: Stance training. +1 STR, +1 END.
+1 STR. Learn Power Strike.
+1 END. Sword Mastery passive (+10% damage with swords).
+1 STR, +1 END. Learn Guard Break (reduces target DR).
+2 STR. Warrior's Resolve: +20% damage when below 30% HP. Unlocks Knight and Berserker tiers.

entries.name: Knight
entries.description: Disciplined defender. Trades raw output for staying power and party protection.

levels.description: +2 END. Shield Brace (+5 DR while defending).
+1 END, +1 STR. Learn Shield Bash (stuns target).
+1 END. Bulwark passive (+1 DR all damage types).
+2 END, +1 STR. Learn Protect Ally (taunt nearby enemies).
+2 END, +2 STR. Indomitable: immune to fear and charm.

entries.name: Berserker
entries.description: Raging assault specialist. Punishes enemies who dared survive a Warrior.

levels.description: +2 STR, +1 AGI. Rage Buildup: +1% crit per round of combat.
+1 STR. Learn Cleave (line AoE).
+1 STR, +1 AGI. Bloodlust: heal 5% max HP on kill.
+2 STR. Learn Berserker Charge (move + attack).
+2 STR, +2 AGI. Frenzy: when below 50% HP, +30% damage but -3 DR.

entries.name: Thief
entries.description: Quick, evasive, lethal from the flank. Future tiers will branch into Rogue and Assassin.

levels.description: Light footwork. +1 AGI, +1 LCK.
+1 AGI. Learn Quick Stab (low-AP single hit).
+1 AGI, +1 LCK. Dodge Step: +5% evasion.
+1 AGI. Learn Pickpocket (chance to steal small loot — flagged for future combat support).
+2 AGI, +1 LCK. Backstab: +25% damage when target has 2+ enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Archer
entries.description: Ranged hunter. Reads the field a beat ahead of the rest of the party.

levels.description: +1 PER, +1 AGI.
+1 PER. Learn Aimed Shot (high accuracy).
+1 PER, +1 LCK. Eagle Eye: +1 basic-attack range.
+1 PER, +1 AGI. Learn Volley (small AoE).
+2 PER, +1 AGI. Marksman: +15% damage to targets at 3+ cells away.
